newsitem.title: CHINA: China brokerage sets up 20 million yuan risk funds.
newsitem.headline: China brokerage sets up 20 million yuan risk funds.

text.p: China's Dapeng Securities Co has decided to set up a 20 million yuan provisional fund in 1997 to offset risk, the Financial News said on Monday.
The Shenzhen-based stock brokerage would set aside 10 percent of its annual post-tax profits each year for the fund, the newspaper said.

The firm aims to boost the fund to 50 percent of its total registered capital, it said. The fund would be used to offset possible financial risks incurred in its businesses and had been approved by its shareholders, it said.
The firms plans to invest the fund in low-risk areas such as treasury bonds, it said.
Most of China's brokerage houses have yet to set up such funds.
